testcase.name: intermediate changes remain protected when the final contents are reverted
committed opt out is respected and old locked content is protected during removal of its rules
new destination and annotated tags include quoted Unicode and tab paths
rename deletion and force rewind protect both old and new paths
source branch tree rules cannot be bypassed through current worktree info or global rules
unknown advertised object requires fetch instead of using stale cached tracking state
new refs exclude already published history while branch updates still check net tree changes
